prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one square 1:1 premium natural commercial catalog photograph, no text, no logo. A SINGLE roll of flexible silver reflective foil laminated AIR-BUBBLE packaging material, horizontal on a seamless warm pale off-white #F6F6F4 studio surface. Three-quarter view with kraft cardboard core visible at left, a short unrolled sheet extending forward and gently curling up at one corner to reveal transparent pale grey polyethylene air bubbles on the reverse. Critical identity: one layer of small evenly spaced round sealed air cells; thin silver reflective face conforming gently over cells, subtle real wrinkles and restrained metallic reflections; clear bubble reverse, NOT white EPE foam, NOT fabric, NOT rigid metal, no quilted squares. Medium-width roll, width about 2.2 times diameter, naturally wound bubbly edges, no impossible solid foam rings. Whole roll and sheet fully in frame, occupy around 75% of square canvas, 12% safe margins. Soft large-window lighting, believable contact shadows, crisp yet not over-sharpened material. This is an original generic unbranded product visualization for a proposed made-to-order structure, not a photographed manufacturer's item. Do not imitate a specific competitor arrangement; just one roll.

Create a new square 1:1 photograph for the SAME foil air-bubble packaging roll product shown in reference. Keep identical small round single-layer air cells, silver reflective face and translucent clear bubble reverse, thin laminate and kraft core where visible. NOT EPE white foam or woven fabric. Warm pale #F6F6F4 seamless background, soft natural studio light, subtle believable contact shadow, realistic thin material, no text/logo/watermark, no numeric specifications or invented test results. Original composition, complete subjects with 10-15% safe margin. A single rectangular material sample resting in a broad gentle S curve, its front portion silver face up, raised back portion showing clear bubble reverse. Clear air cells visible, natural attached laminate edge, no dramatic peeling or delamination. Buyer can compare the two faces and flexibility. Sample only, no roll.

corrections.prompt: Replace the physically ambiguous S-shaped sample with TWO small flat rectangular swatches of the SAME material side by side at a slight angle: left swatch smooth silver reflective laminated face up with subtle cell impressions; right swatch clear raised round air bubbles up, but with continuous silver backing underneath the bubbles so the whole swatch is OPAQUE (no see-through background). Both flat on the surface, complete straight edges, thin flexible laminate, no foam. No peeling layers, no disconnected floating pieces. Keep same small bubble size, bright neutral silver texture, warm #F6F6F4 seamless backdrop, natural photographic lighting, square composition with 12% margins. Two swatches show opposite faces of the same material, not two different materials. No text, logos, rulers or numbers.

Correct only the transparency/material continuity of the trial-wrap foreground: both top overlap flaps must be OPAQUE silver-backed bubble laminate, never see-through to the brown box. On reverse areas show clear raised round air cells over continuous metallic silver backing. Keep the plain brown CLOSED carton front visible and the intentionally open overlap for inspection; no tape, no claims of complete thermal closure. Retain the roll in background, exact same foil bubble material and core, natural soft photograph, square #F6F6F4 background and complete object margins. No white EPE foam, no text/logo. Do not change carton scale or add objects.
